offering_description.value: Expeditors arranges international freight transportation, customs clearance and distribution for businesses that ship goods. It buys cargo space from carriers and coordinates shipments through its global branch network.

primary_services.value: air freight forwarding; ocean freight forwarding; customs brokerage; ground transportation coordination; warehousing and distribution

customer_segment.value: B2B: Importers, exporters, manufacturers, retailers and wholesalers

end_markets.value: retail and consumer goods; technology and electronics; industrial manufacturing; automotive; healthcare and life sciences

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Per-shipment charges for freight forwarding and transportation coordination; service fees: Customs clearance, warehousing, distribution and trade compliance services
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Combines carrier capacity, customs expertise and local handling to move and clear shipments for commercial shippers

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: Air and ocean forwarding, customs brokerage, ground transportation, warehousing and distribution

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Local sales teams and global account managers serving commercial shippers; own locations: Company-operated freight forwarding and customs brokerage offices

regulatory_exposure.value: high: U.S. customs brokerage and ocean transportation intermediary licensing through Customs and Border Protection and the Federal Maritime Commission
